title: Drawing Colored Rectangles with ezgraphics
description: Open an ezgraphics window, get its canvas, and draw two rectangles using RGB fill and outline colors.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Import ezgraphics, create a GraphicsWindow titled 'My First Drawing' with the supplied dimensions, and get its drawing surface with win.canvas().
Set the fill color to full red with zero green and blue, then draw a rectangle at the supplied position and dimensions.

steps.question: What fill color and outline color will the second rectangle have?
steps.answer: The RGB fill mixes full red, green, and blue for white. The outline uses full green with zero red and blue for bright green.

steps.description: Set a white fill and green outline, draw the second rectangle at the supplied position and dimensions, and call win.wait() so the window stays open.
